mapper.insert: INSERT INTO PARTICIPANT (ROOM_ID, NICKNAME, IS_HOST, IS_READY, PREF_LAT, PREF_LNG, JOINED_AT) VALUES (#{roomId}, #{playerName}, 'N', 'N', 0, 0, SYSTIMESTAMP)
mapper.select: SELECT R.ROOM_ID, R.ROOM_UUID AS GAME_UUID, R.CREATED_AT, (SELECT TO_CHAR(P.PARTICIPANT_ID) FROM PARTICIPANT P WHERE P.ROOM_ID = R.ROOM_ID AND P.IS_HOST = 'Y' AND P.LEFT_AT IS NULL FETCH FIRST 1 ROW ONLY) AS HOST_PLAYER_ID FROM ROOM R WHERE R.ROOM_ID = #{roomId}

SELECT R.ROOM_ID, R.ROOM_UUID AS GAME_UUID, R.CREATED_AT, (SELECT TO_CHAR(P.PARTICIPANT_ID) FROM PARTICIPANT P WHERE P.ROOM_ID = R.ROOM_ID AND P.IS_HOST = 'Y' AND P.LEFT_AT IS NULL FETCH FIRST 1 ROW ONLY) AS HOST_PLAYER_ID FROM ROOM R WHERE R.ROOM_ID = #{roomId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT PARTICIPANT_ID, TO_CHAR(PARTICIPANT_ID) AS PLAYER_ID, ROOM_ID, NICKNAME AS PLAYER_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ROOM_ID ORDER BY JOINED_AT, PARTICIPANT_ID) AS PLAYER_ORDER, CASE WHEN LEFT_AT IS NULL THEN 'ACTIVE' ELSE 'LEFT' END AS PLAYER_STATUS FROM PARTICIPANT WHERE ROOM_ID = #{roomId} AND LEFT_AT IS NULL ORDER BY PLAYER_ORDER
SELECT TO_CHAR(PARTICIPANT_ID) FROM PARTICIPANT WHERE ROOM_ID = #{roomId} AND LEFT_AT IS NULL ORDER BY JOINED_AT, PARTICIPANT_ID FETCH FIRST 1 ROW ONLY
